turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I was told my iron was low.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your ferritin is 12, which is low.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Is that why I am tired?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It can be. Any heavy periods or black stools?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Start ferrous sulfate 325 mg once daily with orange juice.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Three months, then we recheck the ferritin.
